children: CleanSpark said it has completed a $2.276 billion debt financing for its data center project in Sandersville, Georgia. According to ChainCatcher, the notes carry a 7.875% interest rate and the proceeds will be used for project construction and to repay equity capital previously invested in the project.
The Sandersville project includes a 20-year lease.

title: CleanSpark Completes $2.276 Billion Debt Financing for Georgia Data Center Project
